limitations: Success-scope counts are JUnit testcase counts printed after XML failure/error check. XML could not be independently inspected because artifact local retrieval returned HTTP 403; skipped testcase counts are unavailable.
Public inventory validation used -Regenerate, so it does not complete the final committed read-only inventory gate.
Headless Windows export and Linux software rendering do not prove graphical Windows/accessibility acceptance.
Performance is process-cold on one shared Windows runner, not flushed filesystem-cache or hardware input-to-paint proof.
Desktop fixes and separate Quick changes prepared later are not validated by this run.
